title: Peace of mind from the first tap.

cards.title: No passwords
cards.body: Sign in with a one-time code sent by WhatsApp or email.

cards.title: Secure payments via Stripe
cards.body: Pay by card, or with Apple Pay and Google Pay.

cards.title: We don’t store your card
cards.body: Payments go through Stripe; your card number is never saved with us.

cards.title: Your privacy, protected
cards.body: GDPR-compliant — the EU’s data protection standard.
